node.title: Shifted quadratic survivors are exact shifted-subgroup product multiplicities
node.closure: exact first moments, energy identity, H-scaling, and reciprocal parameter transport
node.statement: For the official shifted-inversion graph, let R count ordered product representations (x+tau)(y+tau)=kappa on H, F count fixed points, and I=R-F. Then I is even and I/2 counts fibers; the sums over nonzero kappa are (N-z)^2, N-z, and (N-z)(N-z-1), respectively. The second moment of R is the multiplicative energy of (H+tau) without zero. H-scaling reduces tau to 1016 cosets and preserves lambda=kappa/tau^2. Coordinate inversion transports nondegenerate parameters by A=tau^2-kappa, while kappa=tau^2 becomes u+v=-1/tau. No pointwise cap is claimed.
